mapper.sql: id, user_id, dict_type, name, color, sort_order, usage_count, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM res_metadata_dictionary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dict_type = #{dictType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, usage_count DESC, name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO res_metadata_dictionary(user_id, dict_type, name, color, sort_order, usage_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{user_id}, #{dict_type}, #{name}, #{color}, #{sort_order}, #{usage_count}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO res_metadata_dictionary(user_id, dict_type, name, color, sort_order, usage_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{user_id}, #{dict_type}, #{name}, #{color}, #{sort_order}, #{usage_count}, 1, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, color = COALESCE(VALUES(color), color), sort_order = COALESCE(VALUES(sort_order), sort_order), updated_at = NOW()
